svg.text: Four-tier modular architecture illustrating Phase 1 production infrastructure and Phase 2 100k-concurrency distributed evolution

g.text: Tier 1 — Client Browser (React 19 + Vite, Zero-Install Native Web Standards — NFR-44, NFR-54, NFR-55)
Visual Git Diff UI, Virtualized Tree
Tier 2 — Network Edge & Ingress (Phase 1 Nginx TLS Reverse Proxy | Phase 2 AWS NLB + Envoy Ring-Hash)
Nginx Reverse Proxy (Phase 1 — NFR-33, NFR-41, NFR-42)
TLSv1.2/1.3, 1y Immutable Static (.br/.gz), 24h WS Proxy, limit_req
AWS NLB (L4) + Envoy Fleet (Phase 2 — SDR-02, SDR-04)
Consistent Ring-Hash on ?roomId=, 1000 conn/s Token Bucket
Tier 3 — Modular Stateless Backend (Node.js + Express, PM2 Cluster Mode — NFR-32, NFR-48, NFR-51, SDR-01)
Control Plane — Stateless REST API Modules (Helmet NFR-28, Rate Limit NFR-35)
Data Plane — Real-Time Sync & Signalling (NFR-52, NFR-53, SDR-01)
Tier 4 — Persistence, Off-Hot-Path Messaging, Compute Sandbox & Observability
Phase 2 SRS v2.0 Enterprise Scale Extensions (Dashed)
